camera_psychology: extreme wide establishing shot; awe creates scale and negative space, making the couple feel tiny but chosen
visual: A cool blue-lavender twilight seaside or open-sky frame in neutral ivory watercolor. The couple is small in the lower third, standing close but not posed. She has just noticed something in the sky; his posture is already angled toward her. The sky and sea are large, soft, and quiet, not dense or golden.
story_job: Let the viewer enter through the obvious spectacle before the carousel redirects attention to the relationship.
must_show: couple small together in lower frame
his body subtly oriented toward her
clean upper-middle negative space for exact text
cool ivory and blue-lavender dusk palette
avoid: characters too tiny to read emotionally

camera_psychology: medium push-in with selective-attention reversal; the expected focal point is the sky, but his eye-line makes her the reward
visual: Camera moves closer from behind/three-quarter side. Her arm points upward, face lit with small excited wonder as if she has just said the line. He is beside her, but his eyes are already moving toward her expression instead of the sky. Their shoulders almost touch. The sky remains visible only as context, in cool blue-lavender dusk.
story_job: Reveal the private meaning inside the public scene: the spectacle matters less than the person experiencing it.
must_show: his gaze clearly landing on her
no speech bubbles or extra labels
cool ivory and blue-lavender dusk palette
avoid: generic couple pose without eye-line story

camera_psychology: close-up attachment payoff; tactile cues and proximity replace spectacle, making the viewer feel emotional safety
visual: An intimate close-up or middle-close frame that completes the gaze reversal. She is still carrying the tiny excitement of the sky; he is looking at her with soft amused tenderness. Their hands are close or lightly interlaced, one shared bag/scarf/phone detail visible, shoulders leaning toward each other. The cool sky fades into neutral ivory paper behind them.
story_job: Land the emotional click through his gaze, not an abstract thesis.
must_show: hands or shoulders as tactile proof
soft shared movement away from the big view
faces or profiles warm and recognizable
background fading into neutral ivory paper
cool ivory and blue-lavender dusk palette
